Sean / all — quick legal read and blocking items below. Quoted Jane's email for context.

On Mon, 21 Jun 2027 at 09:14 AM Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com> wrote:
> Attaching the latest MSA redlines and our updated order form (v2) — both are tracked PDFs. Legal had two high-level asks we want to capture in the MAP:
>
> - Confirmation of data retention terms (Section 5.3): Acme needs a 7-year retention window for audit logs.
> - KMS/HSM integration: we will require details on key management options and timeline for any private deployment.

Summary from legal review (high level):
- Data retention (Section 5.3): 7 years is longer than our standard 2 years for audit logs. Proposed compromise: Redwood to offer configurable retention up to 7 years for audit logs in Dedicated/Private deployments only; Hosted customers retain up to 2 years by default. OWNER: laura_bennett — deliver proposed contract language by 2027-06-25.

- KMS/HSM: We can support BYOK with HSM integration, but it requires network changes and additional security review — estimate 3-4 week workstream for Private deployment. OWNER: marissa_cole — provide architecture note + high-level timeline by 2027-07-05.

- Liability / indemnity redline: there is a requested change to cap liability which looks acceptable with a carveout for gross negligence. I will flag any non-starter language in a separate comment. OWNER: laura_bennett — follow-up redline comment in redlines_acme_msa.pdf by 2027-06-25.

Action items updated in MAP (internal):
1) Laura: MSA proposed text for retention and liability carveouts — due 2027-06-25
2) Karthik: Confirm billing/legal contact for order form & confirm if any amendment to payment term length is needed — due 2027-06-24
3) Dev: Start vendor portal access request for Acme (SAML setup ticket) and create onboarding ticket for infra — due 2027-07-02
4) Marissa: KMS/HSM architecture + ETA for Private deployment path — due 2027-07-05

I'll mark items as 'blocking' in the MAP doc where sign-off is required to move to procurement.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
